title: Senior Software Engineer, Agent Tracing
salary: €81K – €220K • Offers Equity • Plus up to 20% bonus
description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Agents are becoming the default way developers ship LLM-powered software, and they are miserable to debug. A single run fans out across model calls, tool calls, retries, handoffs between agents, and multi-turn conversations that only make sense as a whole. When one goes wrong, the developer usually has a log line and a shrug.

Sentry's Agent Tracing https://docs.sentry.io/product/agents/ turns that into something you can actually inspect: agent runs, tool calls, model interactions, token usage and cost, conversations you can replay message by message.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Telemetry Experience team, you'll own that product surface - Python/Django and Postgres on the backend, React and TypeScript on the frontend, sitting on top of Sentry's trace storage. You'll work with the SDK engineers who instrument the agent frameworks upstream and own everything customers touch downstream: the dashboards, the conversation views, the APIs, and the workflows that turn a confusing agent run into an obvious fix.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

- Own projects end to end. Take a problem from a rough customer complaint through scoping, design, implementation across the stack, rollout, and measurement. You'll write the design doc, cut the work into shippable pieces, and stay with it until the numbers move.

- Build the views developers debug agents in. Multi-agent workflows, conversation replay, cost and token breakdowns, the moment where a run failed and why. Making a deeply nested, wildly variable trace legible is a genuinely hard interface problem.

- Make the data underneath fast and queryable. Filtering and sorting millions of conversations, getting cost calculation right, and designing APIs that both humans and other people's agents can use well.

- Detect the failures worth flagging. We're expanding from showing developers what happened to telling them what went wrong - common agent failure classes surfaced as issues, not as something you have to go looking for.

- Take the friction out of getting started. Setup should be trivial on any stack, whether a developer wires it up by hand or asks their coding agent to do it.

- Collaborate daily with product managers, designers, SDK engineers, and other product engineers. You'll bring the technical perspective that makes a design better, explain constraints in terms of what they cost the user, and sweat the details other people skip: empty states, error messages, loading behavior, the edge case that only bites 2% of accounts.

YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

- You'd rather own an outcome than a ticket. You take ambiguous problems, decide what to build, drive it across team boundaries, and follow through after launch. Nobody has to hand you a spec.

- You're obsessed with making an experience smooth. Friction offends you. You notice the extra click, the confusing label, the query that takes 400ms too long - and you fix them instead of filing them.

- You solve problems for customers, not for the codebase. Sentry's users are developers, so you can read their bug reports, sit in their tooling, and tell the difference between what they asked for and what they need.

- You communicate well in writing. Working across SDK teams, product, and design in a distributed company means your docs, PR descriptions, and updates do a lot of the work.

- You want to build in a space that's still being figured out. Nobody has settled what agent observability should look like. You'd rather help decide that than implement someone else's finished answer.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of professional experience building and shipping full-stack web applicat

Interview Process

What Happens After You Apply
Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video . It’s a short, self-recorded video that completes your application and allows hiring managers to get to know you before the interview process begins.

description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 690,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. Learn more at  EverCommerce .com.
We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:
Position Summary
EverCommerce is seeking a Vice President, FP&A to lead the financial planning and analysis function for the EverHealth vertical business unit. Reporting to the EverCommerce CFO, this leader will serve as the primary finance partner to the EverHealth executive leadership team and will be responsible for translating operational performance, revenue trends, investment decisions, and strategic priorities into clear financial plans, forecasts, recommendations, and executive narratives.

• Translate financial and operating data into actionable recommendations for executive decisions, resource allocation, prioritization, and performance improvement.

• Partner with Revenue Operations and commercial leaders on bookings, pipeline, pricing, retention, implementation capacity, bad debt, credits, and revenue forecast accuracy.

• Partner with Product and Engineering on capitalization, product investment, operating metrics, roadmap affordability, headcount planning, and ROI of strategic initiatives.

• Partner with Accounting, Legal, and Corporate Finance on accounting close alignment, EBITDA adjustments, accruals, indemnity/litigation matters, and finance governance.

• Oversee financial review and approval workflows for headcount, job requisitions, operating expenses, vendor spend, travel, and other budget-impacting decisions.

Executive Reporting and Strategic Decision Support

title: KYC产品经理
description:
• 这个职位为何存在？它解决什么问题？我们为什么现在需要它？

KYC 是用户准入的第一道门，直接影响转化率、欺诈与合规成本。该岗位存在的意义是：把「能过审」变成「又好又快又准」的产品体验，用指标体系定位链路断点，并用竞品与技术扫描保持方案不过时。现在需要它，是因为业务增长与审核精度、自动规则、法规解读之间需要专人持续做产品化平衡，而不是靠运营或风控临时补位。

• 核心职责（3-5条）

• 主导 KYC 产品功能设计与体验优化，提升流程转化率与核验准确性。

• 搭建并维护 KYC 数据指标体系，定期采集与分析使用数据，识别并推动解决转化链路中的关键痛点。

• 持续跟踪行业与竞品动态，结构化输出竞品能力、差异点与市场策略，反哺产品路线与优先级。

• 研究并评估新兴 KYC 技术（如 AI 身份识别、区块链数据共享等），判断其适用场景、风险边界与对现有产品的价值，形成可落地的引入或试点建议。

• 理想候选人是什么样的？
熟悉 KYC 全链路语言--从用户填表、证件采集、活体/OCR 到自动审核与人工兜底--并能用数据说话：先定义「哪里漏、哪里卡、哪里误杀」，再改交互与策略。对「秒过」有工程化理解：知道在什么合规与风险边界下追求极致体验，而不是单纯追求表面通过率。习惯主动扫厂商能力与行业方案，比较优劣后能写清楚「我们为什么选 A 不选 B」。能把法规要求读进产品规格里，而不是停留在合规部门的 PPT 上。

• 吸引人的亮点（1-2条）

• 工作直接挂钩 转化率与准确性 等可感知业务结果，改动能快速在数据上验证。

• 可深度接触 AI 身份识别、OCR、自动审核与风控规则 的交叉地带，并参与前沿技术方案的评估与落地路径设计。

title: Senior Customer Care Lead
description:
About Sharebite

Sharebite is the leading food ordering platform built for companies to feed their employees. Our platform allows their employees to place meal orders with their favorite restaurants while helping to combat food insecurity in local communities. Every meal ordered on Sharebite results in a meal donation through local partners like Feeding America and City Harvest, and to date, we have donated over 15 million meals.
About This Role
As a Senior Customer Care Lead, your role combines hands-on support for our customers and restaurant partners with ownership of operational initiatives that help our teams scale efficiently. You’ll maintain direct involvement in live operations while also helping improve internal processes, documentation, reporting, and product workflows.
This role is split across two key areas: Group Order Operations, where you will manage real-time order execution and client relationships with a high degree of ownership, and Care Team Operations Projects, where you will contribute to a variety of product and process improvement initiatives.
If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love solving problems at the intersection of operations and innovation, and want to grow into a broader operational role at a mission-driven company, this is the role for you.
What You’ll Do

• Serve as a senior point of contact for Group Order clients and restaurant partners during live order windows, handling real-time issues with urgency and professionalism.

• Manage and resolve order escalations and customer complaints, setting the standard for quality and speed across the team.

• Respond to inbound support requests, phone, email, and chat, in a fast-paced, time critical manner, modeling best in class support behaviors.

• Contribute to project execution alongside the Customer Operations Project Manager - taking ownership of defined workstreams, tracking deliverables, and coordinating with stakeholders to keep initiatives on schedule.

• Own and maintain external-facing knowledge base content, including Help Center articles and chatbot materials, keeping them current, accurate, and reflective of the most common client issues.

• Support the scoping, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of third-party tools and systems used by the Care team, from launch through steady-state operations.

• Collaborate with Care team leads to identify recurring issues and gaps that would benefit from documentation, process changes, or product feedback.

• Surface operational insights and trends from your live ops work to inform product and process improvement efforts.

Required Skills & Experience

• 5+ years in a customer support, customer success, or operations role, preferably at a high-growth tech company.

• Comfortable reviewing support and operational data, spotting trends, and turning them into actionable insights for product and process decisions.

• Excellent phone and written communication skills; you are confident, clear, and professional under pressure.

• Strong problem-solving instincts, you can assess a situation quickly, act decisively, and communicate your decisions effectively.

• Demonstrated ability to handle escalations and difficult conversations with composure and empathy.

• Experience contributing to projects or cross-functional initiatives, with an ability to manage tasks and deadlines independently.

• Collaborative and team-oriented, with a track record of going beyond your own role to support others.

At Sharebite , we are committed to providing competitive pay and benefits that are in line with industry and market standards. The base compensation range for this role is $65,000 - $75,000 per year, however actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, and location.
Salary is just one component of Sharebite 's total compensation package, which includes equity, multiple health insurance options

Together AI is scaling its own data center infrastructure to power the next generation of AI workloads. In this role, you will manage critical data center builds, coordinate infrastructure deployment, and drive projects from contract negotiation through commissioning and data center fit out with vendors and strategic partners. You will own the full deployment lifecycle, ensuring builds are delivered on time, on budget, and to the quality standards required for high-density AI compute environments.
Responsibilities

• Experience managing high-density compute deployments, including cluster-level cabling, rack-level power distribution, and OEM/ODM staging workflows.

• Strong understanding of data center MEP systems, data hall fit out, structured cabling, and white space delivery.

• Experience managing multi-million infrastructure budgets and tracking costs and timelines across multiple concurrent projects.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical construction and delivery details for non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.

• Familiarity with high-density GPU compute environments, liquid cooling systems, or AI infrastructure requirements.

• Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Business or a related field.

• PMP certification or equivalent project management credential.

Nice to Have

• Experience with fast-track or modular delivery methods for data center or mission-critical facilities.

title: Contract Due Diligence Compliance Analyst
description:
Your Opportunity:
Maxwell was founded in 2015 by homebuyers who were shocked by the complexity and inefficiencies of the mortgage process for borrowers and lending teams alike. We've built a platform that has not only streamlined the process and made it more efficient - closing loans 45%+ faster - but has made mortgages more accessible in the process. As our Contract Due Diligence Compliance Analyst, you'll dig into loan files and fees to validate regulatory compliance, working cross-functionally with our Data Capture, Credit Review, and Transaction Management teams to ensure a smooth transition from Compliance Analysis to Credit Review and beyond. This is a remote role open across the United States. If you thrive on detail, believe compliance and efficiency aren't at odds, and want to help spread financial empowerment, this is your Maxwell .
What You're Great At:
You are someone who enjoys digging in to ensure loan files and fees are accurate and compliant with regulatory standards. You understand what's needed to properly investigate and validate apparent regulatory compliance violations. Specifically, you bring:

• Strong working knowledge and experience in the LauraMac Due Diligence software system

• 3 years of experience in Quality Control/Due Diligence/Secondary Market (required), with fraud investigative review experience within banking or lending preferred

• Knowledge of the principles and compliance regulations and documentation applicable to mortgage lending

• The ability to meet production quality and service standards

• High technical aptitude, with familiarity with Slack, Zoom, GSuite, and Microsoft Office

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with analytical ability, good judgment, and a detail-oriented, organized approach

What You'll Do:

• Review loan packages, underwriting guidelines, or data files to identify the documentation necessary for the review

• Capture required information from such documentation, including bookmarking relevant pages where such information can be located, in a designated place

• Audit loans to determine salability or conduct final review of loan documentation for accuracy and completeness

• Identify and document any discrepancies during audit, tracking document issues in the process

• Enter data and fees from LEs, CDs, and COCs into the system of record and run analysis to test for issues

• Ensure any exceptions are captured and recorded for incorrect or missing documentation, data errors, and any errors on the LEs and CDs

• Research and respond to rebuttals and responses to findings

• Maintain communication with internal contacts as necessary to ensure expectations and timelines are met, escalating issues as needed

• Run system logic against information captured and handle any exceptions that may come from applying that logic against the data captured

• Apply exceptions and handle validations where necessary to ensure a complete and accurate review

• Accurately track time spent on reviews

Salary: This is a contract position and payment will be made per file, depending on the type of loan reviewed.
Why Maxwell :
We are a company focused on a supportive, diverse, and inclusive culture - lived through our values of Rigor, Ownership, Curiosity, Kindness, and "Straight Up" - to bring equality to the mortgage process and spread financial empowerment. We believe people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and given the tools to solve real problems. title: OEML - Senior Compliance Analyst
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe crypto will help reshape the future and contribute to greater individual freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions of customers access to crypto trading and decentralised applications. OKX is also trusted by institutions seeking secure access to crypto markets and is supported by its Proof of Reserves programme.

Across our global offices, we are united by three core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These values shape how we work and help us create a collaborative, rewarding and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Team

The Compliance function is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the safe, sustainable growth of OKX. We are a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on regulatory obligations, conduct expectations and enterprise risks.

OKX Europe Markets Limited operates within a significant EU regulatory perimeter as a MiFID II investment firm authorised under the Investment Services Act (Cap. 370), providing dealing on own account and execution of orders on behalf of clients on a matched-principal basis, together with trustee, custodian and nominee services, across the EEA on a cross-border services passport. Our product range includes crypto-asset perpetuals and expiry futures, single stock and ETF-linked futures, commodity futures and crypto-asset options, and is expanding into money market fund and structured product offerings.

About the Opportunity

As the Senior Compliance Analyst for OKX Europe Markets Limited, you will deliver the day-to-day operational compliance work of a fast-growing MiFID II investment firm: financial promotions review, complaints administration, regulatory and trade reporting support, monitoring testing and the firm's regulatory registers.

This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. The function reviews in the order of seventeen pieces of marketing and promotional material each week and handles around five new complaints each week, both scaling with a client base that is growing towards 100,000 users, alongside recurring regulatory reporting, token-listing and licence-extension assessments and compliance monitoring testing. You will be the person who keeps that machinery running accurately and on time.

You will gain broad exposure to MFSA supervision and EU financial services regulation, and direct visibility of how a MiFID II derivatives business is controlled in practice.

The position reports to the Deputy Head of Compliance, with a secondary reporting line to the Head of Compliance and MLRO, OKX Europe Markets Limited.

What You'll Be Doing

You will:

•
Review client-facing marketing material and financial promotions for compliance with MiFID II fair, clear and not misleading standards and the MFSA advertisement rules, across paid and organic social, email, landing pages, banners, push notifications, video and KOL briefs, and prepare them for approval by the Deputy Head of Compliance or the Head of Compliance.

•
Maintain the advertisement and marketing approval register, tracking each item from submission through amendment to approval, and supporting notifications to the MFSA where required.

•
Administer the end-to-end complaints process: logging and triage, investigation, preparation of customer responses within regulatory deadlines, remediation follow-up and escalation of significant or recurring issues to the Deputy Head of Compliance.

•
Produce complaints management information, root-cause and trend analysis to support the function's reporting to senior management, the Risk, Compliance and Audit Committee and the Board.

•
Support trade and transaction reporting obligations, including data collection and validation, regulatory return preparation, review and sign-off coordination, submission and evidence retention.

•
Conduct scheduled and ad-hoc testing under the Compliance Monitoring Programme, docume

title: Director, Industry Marketing - Telecommunications
description:
The Role:
Telecom is at an inflection point. Networks are getting smarter, customer expectations are outpacing legacy systems, and the pressure to monetize 5G while cutting operational costs has never been greater. This is where you come in.
As Director of Industry Marketing for Telecommunications, you'll own the narrative that makes ServiceNow irreplaceable to telco buyers. You know this industry-its pressures, its players, its language-and you know how to translate that knowledge into messaging that stops a CTO or VP of Operations mid-scroll and makes them say, "this is exactly what I need."
But here's what makes this role different: you're not just a storyteller. You're building an AI-first marketing motion-one where AI agents, automated content workflows, and intelligent buyer signals are baked into how your team operates every day.
What You'll Do

•
Own the industry narrative. Define ServiceNow 's point of view for Telecom-crafting narratives that connect platform and portfolio capabilities to the real problems telco buying groups are solving right now: network operations transformation, BSS/OSS modernization, field service efficiency, and customer experience reinvention. Use AI to accelerate your industry research, synthesize competitive signals, and stress-test your messaging before it ever hits a sales deck.

•
Build buyer-specific messaging. Architect messaging tailored to distinct buyer personas-CIO, COO, Chief Network Officer, VP of Customer Operations-that moves from "we have a problem" to " ServiceNow is the answer." Leverage AI to generate, pressure-test, and rapidly iterate persona-specific content so your team ships more, faster, without sacrificing quality.

•
Set the AI-first standard across the team. Model what it looks like to use AI tools as a core part of the marketing workflow, not a nice-to-have. Coach your colleagues on how to build repeatable, AI-assisted content systems that scale your output and raise the quality bar across the board.

•
Drive pipeline, not just awareness. Partner closely with product marketing, Industry Go-to-Market, and field marketing to ensure industry narratives translate into pipeline-generating plays.

•
Run an AI-embedded content engine. Build thought leadership, executive briefs, event programming, and digital assets where AI is embedded in how content gets researched, drafted, personalized, and distributed. The expectation isn't just that you use AI-it's that your team can't imagine working without it.

•
Stay ahead of the industry. Track BSS/OSS players, hyperscaler partnerships, industry ecosystem dynamics, and the competitive landscape so your messaging is always credible and current. Use AI-powered listening and synthesis tools to monitor signals at a pace that would be impossible manually.

•
Represent ServiceNow externally. Show up at industry events, analyst briefings, and customer forums as a credible voice on telco transformation-and on what AI-powered marketing looks like in practice.

Why This Matters
Telcos are running some of the most complex operations on the planet-millions of customers, thousands of field technicians, aging infrastructure, and a mandate to transform while the lights stay on. The right narrative doesn't just win deals. It shifts how an entire industry thinks about what's possible. That's the opportunity in front of you.

• 12+ years of experience in B2B marketing, including 3-5+ years focused on the telecommunications industry or a similar vertical-specific marketing role.

• Deep familiarity with the telecommunications industry-either from inside a telco, a key vendor in the ecosystem, or years of focused industry marketing coverage. You know what a telecom transformation really means, and you can talk to a network ops leader without a glossary.

• Proven track record building industry or vertical marketing programs that influence pipeline-not just brand impressions.

• A sharp instinct for buyer psyc

Bonjour ! Merci de votre visite 👋

Vous êtes activement à la recherche d'une nouvelle opportunité ? Ou vous souhaitez simplement vous renseigner sur le marché ? Eh bien... vous êtes peut-être au bon endroit !

Nous sommes à la recherche d’ un(e) Gestionnaire principal(e) des relations publiques (contrat à durée déterminée de 13 mois) au sein de l'équipe des communications mondiales de Lightspeed, basée à Montréal. Relevant du directeur des relations publiques, vous développerez et piloterez des récits institutionnels et sectoriels en Amérique du Nord et au Québec, contribuant ainsi à renforcer la notoriété et l'influence de Lightspeed auprès des médias, des clients, des partenaires et des principales parties prenantes.

Ce poste stratégique et opérationnel s'adresse à un(e) expert(e) en communication capable de relier les priorités commerciales à la communication externe, de conseiller la haute direction, d'influencer les partenaires interfonctionnels et de mettre en œuvre des communications de haute qualité dans un environnement technologique en constante évolution.

Il s'agit d'un contrat à durée déterminée de 13 mois.

Vos responsabilités :

Rapport institutionnel et stratégie médias

- Développer et piloter des récits institutionnels et sectoriels en Amérique du Nord et au Québec, notre province d'origine, afin de renforcer la notoriété et l'influence de Lightspeed.

- Collaborer étroitement avec le directeur des relations publiques pour définir la position de Lightspeed sur les enjeux politiques au Canada et aux États-Unis, et accroître la visibilité de l'entreprise auprès de la presse spécialisée en technologies d'affaires et d'entreprise, ainsi que des médias grand public. Développer et entretenir des relations avec les journalistes et les influenceurs des secteurs technologique et commercial.

- Piloter les relations médias proactives et les prises de contact au Canada et au Québec, en identifiant le sujet, le porte-parole, le moment opportun et le média les plus pertinents pour les récits corporatifs, produits, clients, données et sectoriels.

- Posséder une solide connaissance du paysage médiatique canadien, y compris québécois, et diriger la stratégie et la mise en œuvre des relations publiques de Lightspeed au Canada, tout en soutenant les priorités de communication nord-américaines.

- Trouver des moyens créatifs de rapprocher Lightspeed et nos secteurs d'activité de leurs clients et d'intégrer la vision et la feuille de route des produits de Lightspeed dans l'actualité.

Collaboration et narration interfonctionnelles

- Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes et les hauts dirigeants pour comprendre leurs objectifs stratégiques et aligner les initiatives de communication en conséquence, notamment les mises à jour de produits et les occasions de raconter des histoires sur les clients, les partenaires et les données.

- Coordonner avec les équipes de science des données et d'analyse commerciale, ainsi qu'avec les fournisseurs externes, l'élaboration d'un calendrier d'occasions de science des données liées aux annonces de produits et aux événements phares. • Élaborer des plans qui anticipent les besoins et les défis spécifiques des parties prenantes internes et aligner les communications sur les objectifs et priorités organisationnels globaux.

Production de contenu et de communications

- Rédiger, réviser et produire des communications de haute qualité pour les publics externes, notamment des présentations, des communiqués de presse, des notes d'information, des discours et des articles signés.

- Réviser les communications des partenaires de presse et des agences et formuler des recommandations afin de garantir la cohérence des messages avec la stratégie et le ton de communication globaux.

- Faire preuve de créativité, de rigueur et d'ouverture d'esprit, en se concentrant sur la création de solutions et d'opportunités par le biais des activités de communication.

Full-Time, Part-Time, or Contract | Competitive Compensation + Performance Incentives
About GigaKOM
For more than 20 years, GigaKOM has delivered enterprise-level IT solutions to California K-12 school districts, higher education institutions, state and local government agencies, and commercial organizations. Through partnerships with leading manufacturers and technology providers-including Cisco, HPE Aruba, and top cybersecurity vendors-we design and deliver secure, scalable solutions that protect mission-critical environments.
As cybersecurity continues to be a top priority for our clients, GigaKOM is expanding its security practice and seeking a Senior Solutions Architect - Cybersecurity to lead the design and evolution of advanced security architectures across enterprise and cloud environments.
Location
Remote - California
This is a fully remote position supporting client environments across California.
Position Overview
The Senior Solutions Architect - Cybersecurity is a strategic, client-facing leadership role responsible for designing, guiding, and advancing cybersecurity architectures across network, cloud, identity, endpoint, and SIEM/XDR environments.
This role serves as a technical authority and trusted advisor, working closely with executive stakeholders, sales teams, and engineering resources to define security strategy, architect solutions, and guide long-term modernization initiatives.
In addition to architecture, this position provides technical oversight, escalation support, and advisory guidance-ensuring security solutions are aligned with best practices, compliance frameworks, and evolving threat landscapes.
This is a high-impact role with the opportunity to influence GigaKOM’s cybersecurity portfolio, standards, and go-to-market strategy.

Lead Cybersecurity Architecture & Strategy

• Establish reusable architectures and security standards across client environments

• Guide long-term security roadmaps aligned with business and compliance objectives

Pre-Sales Leadership & Client Advisory

• Present security strategies to CIOs, CISOs, and executive stakeholders

• Microsoft security ecosystem deployments (Microsoft Entra ID, Defender, Sentinel)

• Network security modernization (firewalls, segmentation, secure access)

• Compliance-driven security frameworks (NIST, CIS, ISO 27001)

Identity, Cloud & Data Security Architecture

• Design identity-first security using Microsoft Entra ID (SSO, MFA, Conditional Access)

• Define governance, access policies, and identity lifecycle management

• Secure workloads, applications, and data across hybrid environments

Security Oversight & Threat Strategy

• Provide escalation-level guidance for complex security incidents

• Guide SIEM strategy, detection engineering, and advanced threat analysis

• Oversee vulnerability management and remediation strategies

title: Director of Product
description:
As Director of Product, your mission is to build the premier product organization in supply chain: disciplined about what you build, iterative in how you build it, obsessed with the customer, and driven by data at every decision.
About Bobtail

Bobtail is dedicated to increasing happiness by eliminating inefficiencies in the supply chain. We envision a supply chain without friction, fraud, waste, and abuse where companies succeed based on the value they create.
We work in a unique way at Bobtail , where we value teams over individuals and encourage experimentation and iteration to constantly improve. Teams are given flexibility in working towards a shared purpose and given the freedom to decide how they will accomplish their goals.
If you are an out of the box thinker that takes a proactive approach in collaborating with others to solve problems and achieve your goals - we would love to talk to you.
The things we value:

• Mission

• Teams over individuals

• Collaboration

• Communication

• Iteration

• Experimentation and failing fast

• Initiative and solutions oriented approach

• Documentation

• Data

• Mental health and work life balance

• Diversity

• Transparency

We're hiring a Director of Product to lead product strategy, development, and innovation at Bobtail . This is a first-of-its-kind seat built around three priorities: deciding what Bobtail builds, deciding what it deliberately does not build, and executing at a high level in lockstep with engineering and the rest of the senior management team to ship it. You'll work directly with the CEO to turn a wide set of strategic options, into a sequenced, evidence-backed roadmap.
The ideal candidate has led product at a company of comparable size and complexity, with a track record of setting strategy from ambiguity rather than just running an existing roadmap, and the discipline to say no as often as yes. This individual will be highly data-driven and analytical, with the judgment to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin. We are looking for a strong product leader who can build the product management function at Bobtail from the ground up, hire and develop a team, and partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market leadership to turn decisions into shipped product. This includes identifying new products, services, platform capabilities, and revenue opportunities that solve meaningful problems for our customers and strengthen our competitive position. The right person will not wait for someone to hand them a list of features to build. They will spend time understanding how our customers operate, where they struggle, what they currently pay others to do, and what problems remain unsolved.
You should apply if you have:

• 8+ years of experience in product management and strategy, including experience leading product at a company of comparable size and complexity.

• A track record of setting product strategy from ambiguity and defending sequencing decisions with both data and judgment.

• Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, lending, factoring, transportation technology, or another transaction-heavy financial environment strongly preferred.

• Experience conducting product discovery, customer research, and market analysis. Strong commercial instincts and the ability to evaluate product opportunities based on customer value and business economics.

• Comfort with compliance and risk constraints (KYC/KYB, lending, payments) is a plus.

• Experience building and leading a product team, including hiring the first few members of a function.

• Strong technical fluency - you don't need to write code, but you should be able to work closely with engineering on architecture trade-offs and technical feasibility.

• Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong pattern-recognition and problem-solving skills.

• A bias toward shipping and iterating over long planning cycles.

• Comfort operating at a founder-led, profitable company rather

Build the Future of Data. Join the Snowflake Team.

We are actively hiring software engineers from Europe and around the world for our European Engineering Center. Our office is located at Potsdamer Platz, in the heart of Berlin. It’s easily accessible by train, subway, bus, or bicycle - with numerous restaurants, cafes, and shops within walking distance. The official language for this office is English.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a team of skilled engineers, building and maintaining the future of the Java infrastructure that powers the data cloud. As part of this team, you will work on the core Java libraries and JVM infrastructure that support our scalable, high-performance platform, impacting millions of users globally.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER ON THE JAVA PLATFORM TEAM, YOU WILL:

- Contribute to building the next-generation systems that make using Java safe, efficient, and secure

- Help provide a consistent, high-performance platform that Snowflake engineers can use to deliver high-quality solutions to production.

- Identify performance and availability issues, implement effective solutions, and instrument key components as needed.

- Collaborate with global teams to solve real-world, large-scale challenges in data infrastructure.

- Continuously improve the reliability and performance of our Java infrastructure through proactive monitoring and automation.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOFTWARE ENGINEERS WHO:

- Have experience building, supporting, and troubleshooting complex Java systems.

- Understand Java fundamentals, including the JVM and core libraries.

- Have solid computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

- Are eager to learn about JVM internals and performance tuning.

- Thrive in collaborative environments, contributing to shared team goals.

- Have a BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience (advanced degrees a plus).

Bonus points for:

- Experience with multi-threading, concurrency, and caching.

- Knowledge of database or Linux internals.

- Previous experience with large-scale, high-performance systems.

Join us and be a part of a team that is driving the future of the data cloud.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Revenue Accountant Manager
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is looking for a Revenue Accountant Manager to own key areas of our revenue accounting and Order to Cash functions in a high-growth SaaS environment. This is a hands-on individual contributor role built for someone who wants deep technical ownership: the deferred revenue process, the end-to-end allowance process, contract modification accounting, and the revenue implications of new AI-driven business models.

You will be a core contributor to the revenue close alongside the broader team, while carrying full ownership of your areas end to end. A significant part of this role is forward-looking: helping shape how Benchling recognizes revenue on consumption-based products and how we track and account for AI partnership economics as those models evolve.

If you are motivated by technical revenue accounting, cross-functional partnership, and building processes for products that do not have a settled playbook yet, we would love to meet you.

This role is based out of the San Francisco HQ and reports to the Head of Revenue Accounting. There are no direct reports, though you will help coach the revenue accounting team and review their work.

- Own the deferred revenue process end to end - deferred revenue, contract asset, and unbilled receivables schedules, rollforwards, reconciliations, and supporting analytics.

- Perform technical analysis for contract modifications, under ASC 606, and lead SSP analyses and complex revenue arrangement memos.

- Own professional services revenue (fixed-fee, T&M) end to end, and drive process optimization across PS revenue with Services Operations.

- Prepare materials and present financial results in quarterly close presentations.

- Own revenue and deferred revenue flux analyses across all streams, and participate in the monthly/quarterly/annual close for your workstreams.

- Lead or assist on special projects such as new product and pricing model launches, entity or geographic expansion.

- Owner for designated audit areas during the annual audit - managing PBC deliverables, resolving auditor inquiries, and driving issues to closure.

Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry - from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park & Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at www.peek.com http://www.peek.com.

As a remote-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day.

THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Manager, Organic Growth to own the strategy and execution of SEO, AEO, and GEO across PeekPro, ACME Ticketing, and Connect&GO.

This is a builder’s role. You will inherit three distinct brands with three distinct audiences, overlapping topical territory, and no unified organic strategy connecting them. Your job is to define that strategy, then run it - deciding which brand should rank for what, where consolidation creates authority and where it creates cannibalization, and how a single portfolio of content earns visibility across both traditional search results and AI-generated answers.

The mandate is demand, not traffic. Experience operators researching software rarely convert on first touch; they compare, they read, they research, and they come back weeks later. You will be measured on organic-sourced pipeline and closed-won revenue across all three brands - not on rankings or sessions alone.

You’ll partner closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Engineering.. You are the connective tissue between them and the subject matter expert within the team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

OWN THE NUMBER

- Carry the organic pipeline target across all three brands. Build the forecast, report against it monthly, and be accountable for organic-attributed opportunities, demos, and closed-won revenue - not just clicks.

DEFINE THE MULTI-BRAND ORGANIC STRATEGY

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Datavant is a data platform company and the world’s leader in health data exchange. Our vision is that every healthcare decision is powered by the right data, at the right time, in the right format.

Our platform is powered by the largest, most diverse health data network in the U.S., enabling data to be secure, accessible and usable to inform better health decisions. Datavant is trusted by the world’s leading life sciences companies, government agencies, and those who deliver and pay for care.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a high-performing, values-driven team. Together, we’re rising to the challenge of tackling some of healthcare’s most complex problems with technology-forward solutions. Datavant ers bring a diversity of professional, educational and life experiences to realize our bold vision for healthcare.

What We’re Looking For
As a Cloud Security Engineer in the Secure Product Infrastructure program, you will be part of a highly technical team actively working to build security into Datavant ’s infrastructure. You’ll play a key role helping to build secure patterns, and enabling engineering teams to move fast, while being secure. You will work closely with teams across the Security function and Engineering on a variety of technologies.
What You Will Do

• Use your strong understanding of cloud security to help Datavant build best-in-class services.

• Work competently in AWS Azure with an understanding of appropriate security patterns.

• Have strong experience and understanding of containerization, as well as operating and securing Kubernetes clusters.

• Dig into cloud identities and access management and refine Datavant ’s access model.

• You will have an understanding of risks, but may have some knowledge gaps in depth of risk management. It’s OK, we’ll teach you. The core skill set you bring to the table is a development mindset.

• Work directly with DevOps peers to help build practical and usable security into the SDLC and AWS.

• Own new projects for advancing security in our environment. Be a technical expert and collaborate with others on the teams to ensure project success. Your impact here cannot be understated, you are a core contributor and have deep influence to empower Datavant greatness.

What You Need to Succeed

• You are humble.

• You have an “automation first” mindset.

• You can build Infrastructure as Code in Terraform. It is expected that you have a “git native” skillset.

• You can articulate start to finish what a secure configuration looks like for a specific project.

• You have opinions and options on most of the steps.

• You are a consummate collaborator, it’s inherent in your work behavior.

• You value time deeply and optimize for greatest impact.

• 3+ years of working in at least 1 major public Cloud provider and a desire to learn a second.

• 2+ years of operating, monitoring and securing Kubernet

Rachio is looking for a Senior Product Manager Hardware to own one of Rachio's hardware lines end to end: the roadmap for that line, the product definition behind each device in it, and the stage gates that take a concept from idea through EVT, DVT, and PVT to a product that ships on time, in full, and at the right cost.
Our hardware portfolio spans smart sprinkler controllers, hose timers, outdoor lighting, and the partner and OEM products we build with and for others, along with the tethered software experiences (setup, control, and device features in the Rachio app) that make them work. You will own a subset of these hardware programs from its roadmap, its definition, requirements, and its results - and how it feeds it into the portfolio roadmap.
The role is inherently technical and inherently commercial. You are measured on shipping products customers love - on time, at cost, and at quality - and on how your line performs in market: activation, returns, CSAT, and attach to software and subscriptions. Not on the volume of specs written. You work daily with Engineering (firmware, electrical, mechanical, and industrial design), Supply Chain and Operations, Design, Support, Finance, and Sales. You will spend real time with customers - homeowners and professional installers - and real time at the factory. This enables our customer driven approach and how we solve customer pain points in our roadmap.
A note on how this role works. Rachio runs a flat organization that maintains high ownership and a fast-paced start-up culture. This is an individual contributor role. Your influence comes from the quality of your product judgment, the clarity of your writing, and your credibility with the engineers, designers, and operators who build what you define. If there is a gap in the organization or resourcing standing between your product and its launch, you are expected to step in and close it. When the same gap shows up a second time, you are expected to fix what produces it.
We also expect you to work AI-natively: using AI for the research synthesis, data analysis, and first drafts that used to take days, so your time goes to customers, evaluating trade-offs, and focusing on strategic debates.

Own your line's roadmap and product definition

• Own the roadmap for your hardware line across new products, line extensions, and lifecycle work on what has already shipped, kept led by data: customer research, product telemetry, support and returns data, channel input, and competitive intelligence.

• Write the "working backwards" documents for each new product and major feature in your line: the customer problem, the value to customers, partners, and channels, the target price and cost, the success criteria, and the questions we have to answer before we commit.

• Turn those into detailed, crisp business requirements and user stories that Engineering and Design can build to, spanning hardware, firmware, and the tethered app experience.

• Manage the trade-offs among customer experience, performance, cost, schedule, and operational support load - and make the call, with a written rationale, when they conflict.

• Feed the portfolio roadmap: bring the Director of Product the evidence, the sequencing constraints, and the bets you think are worth making in your category.

Run the product development process for your line

• Run your line's stage gates as a mechanism, not a meeting: concept through EVT, DVT, PVT, and ramp, with clear owners and exit criteria at each, and an honest review of what we learned at the end.

• Contribute to engineering decisions on technology and architecture - radios and protocols, sensors, power, enclosures - with enough fluency to be useful in the room and to recognize when a decision is a one-way door.

title: Software Architect - Tracking
description:
This is the senior computer vision engineering authority for Hawk-Eye's tracking technology, and it is an individual contributor role.

Our tracking sits underneath almost everything Hawk-Eye sells. Goal-line technology, semi-automated offside, electronic line calling, automated ball-strike. Live and post-game data. It runs across football, baseball, tennis, American football, ice hockey, cricket, basketball and rugby, on-premise, in the cloud and increasingly on edge devices, delivered by over 100 engineers in the Tracking and Automated Officiating value stream.

You would be the person who decides how that is built. The role carries two hats. As Software Architect you own the software-level architectural design across tracking, auto-officiating and data delivery. As computer vision authority you lead the core domains: camera calibration, ball tracking, skeletal tracking, and the R&D that feeds them.

It is a hands-on job. You set architecture for new tracking problems as they arrive, you safeguard the shared frameworks, and when a live delivery is at risk you are the escalation point who gets into the code.

WHAT YOU WOULD OWN

Architecture across the value stream. You are the lead architect for every tracking and auto-officiating product in T&AO. You set the initial architecture when a new tracking problem enters the business, run the Software Domain Owner model so shared libraries like calibration have named codeowners, and keep designs consistent across sports. You represent tracking in the Engineering Architecture Steering group and feed into architecture conversations across Hawk-Eye and the wider Sony Sports organisation.

Part of that is judgement about reuse. Keeping value streams on a common tracking codebase pays off until it doesn't, and knowing where that line sits is the job.

Computer vision direction. You are the subject matter authority. You decide where our vision processing and ML integration goes next, research new tracking technologies and bring them in, and build prototypes when a proposal needs proving rather than describing.

Modern tooling, properly evaluated. We want agentic coding frameworks, LLM-driven development tools and automated code generation working inside heavy C++ and Python codebases, with guidelines that hold up. You would lead that adoption and decide what earns its place.

Growing other engineers. You coach the Squad Tech Leads, guide junior architects, and run CV Algorithm talks, HawkTalks and tutorials. You also help us hire well, including technical assessment for CV and ML roles.

The awkward bits. Operational health of ML training and synthetic data infrastructure sits with you, including escalating the gaps in ownership and support with options attached.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The core of it is deep multi-camera computer vision. Camera calibration including intrinsics, extrinsics, distortion models, anti-wobble and bundle adjustment. Triangulation. 3D ball and pose estimation, skeletal tracking, continuous-time modelling, inverse kinematics.

On top of that:

- Expert cross-platform C++ across Windows and Linux, x86 and ARM, with CMake and real performance profiling ability

- Strong working knowledge of GPU inference (TensorRT, Triton) and ML pipelines (PyTorch, ONNX)

- Proven experience running tracking at scale in AWS, on-premise and on edge devices

- Hands-on use of AI coding agents and LLM orchestration to accelerate algorithm R&D and refactoring in large codebases

- A working understanding of generative AI, synthetic data generation and where they genuinely help real-time CV

The parts that are harder to put in a bullet point. You can set architecture across many squads and sports and make pragmatic calls on reuse, cost and time to market. You write clearly: design documents, proposals with options, explanations a non-technical stakeholder can follow. You are comfortable in front of external engineering partners, which here means Sony, NVIDIA and AWS alongside sports

Du gewinnst neue regionale Werbekunden für VRM am Telefon, qualifizierst warme Leads und buchst hochwertige Termine für unsere Account Executives.

• Telefonische Erstansprache regionaler Werbekunden auf Basis vorqualifizierter Leads

Deine Aufgaben

tags: Génie des procédés, système de production et fabrication avancée
description:
ENGLISH VERSION

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain .
Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.
L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !
Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.
Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.
🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN ( Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties ), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne , avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin.

Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis , reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Les simulations seront réalisées avec le code éléments finis Cœur ( https://gitlab.emse.fr/bruchon/Coeur ) , en s’appuyant sur la bibliothèque PETSc et des solveurs itératifs préconditionnés adaptés aux problèmes de grande taille. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set . Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT .
Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet.

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Une formation en mécanique numérique, mécanique des fluides, éléments finis ou calcul scientifique est recherchée.
Des compétences en C++/Python, calcul haute performance, PETSc, méthodes Level-Set ou traitement d’images 3D seront appréciées.
